fit.policy: Only upper bands with >=3dB mean band event/background contrast receive8 coarse knots. Fit mean-normalized power-curve shape, then unit-amplitude existing-component finite-response gains; two bounded alternations, choose qualified lowest shape error. Original six spectral gates and per-selected-band temporal nonregression both required.
fit.limitations: A low-contrast band keeps its original local envelopes, not an inferred silent or isolated source. Spectral positive-bin excess and band-total temporal excess differ; shape fitting does not treat them as identical energy targets. One fit seed/crop does not establish naturalness, physical RPM or source identity. Runtime components/counts remain unchanged.
